```python
import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title: str, max_len: int = 50) -> str:
    if max_len <= 0:
        return ""

    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", title)
    text = text.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    text = text.lower()

    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")

    if len(slug) <= max_len:
        return slug

    words = slug.split("-")
    if not words:
        return ""

    first_word = words[0]
    if len(first_word) > max_len:
        return first_word[:max_len]

    result = first_word
    for word in words[1:]:
        candidate = f"{result}-{word}"
        if len(candidate) <= max_len:
            result = candidate
        else:
            break

    return result
```
